full_description: Rice has dissolved into a smooth white porridge holding tender fish and fine green aromatics.
taste: Mellow grain softens the salt while retaining gentle ocean sweetness.

full_description: A loose rice gruel contains chopped shellfish and their pale, sweet cooking liquor.
taste: Soft grains taste lightly marine with intermittent chewy, briny morsels.

full_description: Chunks of old bread swell in a fish broth with onion, herbs, and scattered flakes.
taste: Toasted crumb thickens the savoury liquid and mellows its salinity.

full_description: Dark bread slices have absorbed steaming shellfish liquor beneath a heap of opened molluscs.
taste: Sour grain and sweet brine combine in a hearty, peppered mouthful.

full_description: Chopped leafy vegetables and fish cook down together into a thick, green-flecked household pottage.
taste: Fresh bitterness balances soft flakes, onion sweetness, and rich broth.

full_description: Soft root pieces, broken fish, and grain thicken this brown, spoon-standing communal dish.
taste: Earthy sweetness and pepper surround a mild, sustaining fish savour.

full_description: Whole pulses share a dark aromatic stew with firm fish chunks and softened onion.
taste: Earthy beans absorb marine juices while spice warms the thick broth.

full_description: Abundant crustacean and mollusc meats fill a glossy, spice-scented stew intended for communal serving.
taste: Sweet brine, rich stock, and layered aromatics create lavish depth.

full_description: A small whole fish has hardened beside smoke until its skin turned bronze and its body stiff.
taste: Concentrated salt and woodsmoke surround tough, oily flesh.

full_description: Coarse salt crystals remain lodged across a flattened fish side cured firm for storage.
taste: Powerful brine dominates dense flesh with a lingering marine savour.

short_description: a bundle of sun-dried fish strips
full_description: Long pale fish strips have dried leathery and are tied together as a portable ration.
taste: They chew slowly, releasing salt, clean fish sweetness, and sun-warmed oil.

full_description: A thick cooked fish portion has a dark mahogany surface and moist flakes stained by smoke.
taste: Rich flesh carries sweet wood, salt, and a peppery cured depth.

full_description: A translucent slice of cured fish shows dark edges and a silky, firm interior.
taste: Gentle smoke layers over concentrated brine and buttery marine richness.

full_description: Pulled smoked fish is pressed beneath seasoned fat in a squat crock sealed for keeping.
taste: Smoke and pepper permeate rich flakes softened by savoury fat.

full_description: Pale fish pieces are suspended within a clear, trembling savoury jelly shaped in a small mould.
taste: Cool gelatin melts around salty flakes, herbs, and mild acidic sharpness.

full_description: Round eel sections sit in translucent set broth with pepper and green herb fragments.
taste: The cool jelly softens oily flesh and leaves a strong earthy brine.

full_description: Seasoned fermented fish paste has been shaped into small cakes and cooked until their surfaces browned.
taste: Pungent savour, salt, and deep umami-like richness linger insistently.

full_description: Fish pieces and rice have soured together into a compact, leaf-wrapped preserved portion.
taste: Sharp fermentation joins sweet grain, brine, and a powerful mature aroma.

full_description: Fish roe is pressed with salt into a firm amber cake sliced for sparing use.
taste: Intense briny richness and tiny popping grains fill even a small bite.

full_description: A whole roe sac hangs firm and dark-gold after curing in cool aromatic smoke.
taste: Dense eggs taste nutty, salty, smoky, and richly marine.

full_description: Shelled mollusc pieces have shrunk into wrinkled, amber morsels intended for storage or chewing.
taste: Concentrated sweetness and strong brine emerge from their leathery texture.

full_description: Dark orange mussels are threaded tightly on a slender skewer and dried in aromatic smoke.
taste: Chewy morsels carry wood, mineral salt, and concentrated shellfish sweetness.

short_description: a cleaned fish ready for stuffing
full_description: A whole fish has been scaled, gutted, washed, and opened neatly along the belly for a prepared filling.

short_description: a broad boned fish fillet sheet
full_description: Careful knife work has produced a single thin, boneless sheet of fish suitable for rolling or fine cutting.

short_description: a wrapped portion of fish forcemeat
full_description: Finely pounded fish, salt, and aromatics form a smooth dense mass wrapped for shaping into cakes or fillings.

short_description: a bowl of seasoned fish stuffing
full_description: Chopped fish, crumbs, onion, and herbs have been thoroughly mixed into a moist stuffing ready for baking.
An intact roe sac has been washed and trimmed of loose membrane, leaving it ready for curing or cooking.

short_description: a bowl of picked crustacean meat
full_description: Sweet crustacean flesh has been laboriously removed from shell and cartilage without further seasoning or cooking.

short_description: a bowl of cleaned mollusc meats
full_description: Assorted molluscs have been removed from their shells, rinsed free of grit, and gathered for the cook.
Chopped shellfish, coarse bread crumbs, herbs, and seasoning are combined into a loose mixture for stuffing shells.
